title: Luscious Middle-Eastern Shredded Phyllo Knafeh Shisha
description: A rich and silky dessert featuring tender phyllo, caramelized dates, and a hint of Grand Marnier. Perfect for a romantic evening in.
instructions: Cut the phyllo dough into 1-inch squares and set aside.
In a large saucepan, combine the honey, pistachios, Grand Marnier, and 2 tablespoons of the unsalted butter. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the chopped dates to the saucepan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the dates are tender and the liquid has thickened.
In a separate saucepan, melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the shaved bonito flakes to the saucepan and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the heavy cream, rose water, ground cinnamon, salt, and vanilla extract to the saucepan and whisk until combined.
Add the phyllo squares to the saucepan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the phyllo is golden brown and crispy.
Transfer the phyllo to a serving dish and drizzle with the honey-date mixture.
Sprinkle the sugar over the top and serve immediately.
Reheat the knafeh in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.
Serve warm, garnished with additional pistachios and rose petals if desired.
Note: Be careful when working with hot phyllo dough, as it can burn easily.
This dessert is best served immediately, as the phyllo will become soggy if left to sit for too long.
If you want to make this dessert ahead of time, you can assemble the knafeh and refrigerate it for up to 2 hours before baking.
When baking the knafeh, use a kitchen torch to caramelize the sugar on top, if desired.
